column1: # Which playbook describes each node and connector of the tree: `id<TAB>playbook`, one row per node.
# The id is the Excalidraw element id (`fwx playbook list` lists them). The tree is the owner's drawing and
# carries no assignment, so it lives here. Whoever changes a node changes its row and its block in the same job.
# session: supervised session lane, entry 1, and the shared plan nodes
# execute: waves of executors, the checks at the exact commit, the fix attempts and the review
# ui-walk: the UI branch of a part
# factory: entry 2: the factory lane, written by part 5.1
# improve: the weekly improvement cycle, written by part 6.2
# engine-review: the engine workflow, written by part 6.2
# project-config: the project configuration workflow, written by part 6.2
# connector: nodes whose text starts with an arrow: no block, a legal destination of an exit
